nodes.description: Private uint256 randomNumber seeded from keccak256(now) at deployment and regenerated each game.
Public uint256 prizeFund tracking the contract balance as reward pool.
Public uint256 minBet, minimum bet accepted by startGame (0.1 ether initially).
Address owner initialized to msg.sender, used by onlyOwner checks and withdrawals.
Public GameHistory[] log array recording player addresses and guessed numbers.
external onlyOwner function changeMinBet(uint256) that updates minBet.
public payable startGame(uint256) accepting bets, logging history, paying out the balance on a correct guess and reseeding randomNumber.
public onlyOwner withdaw(uint256) transferring requested amount to owner.
Fallback function() public payable that silently accepts ether.
onlyOwner modifier requiring msg.sender == owner before executing the body.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used for identity, ownership and payout.
block.timestamp (now) used as the randomness seed for randomNumber.
msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) external value transfer inside startGame before state finalization.
owner.transfer(_am) external value transfer inside withdaw.
Parameter _number of startGame, the player's guessed number.
Parameter _am of withdaw, the amount the owner withdraws.
Local GameHistory struct built in startGame and pushed to log.

edges.reason: _newMinBet parameter flows into changeMinBet.
changeMinBet writes the new value into minBet.
_number parameter is consumed by startGame as the guess.
msg.sender is used as the player identity inside startGame.
startGame pushes the GameHistory entry into the log array.
startGame triggers the external balance transfer on a correct guess.
msg.sender is the recipient of the external transfer, giving an attacker callback control.
block.timestamp (now) seeds the keccak256-based randomness, making the result miner-influenceable.
The keccak256(now) result is stored into randomNumber.
_am parameter flows into withdaw as the withdrawal amount.
withdaw forwards _am into owner.transfer.
owner state variable is the recipient of the withdrawal transfer.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner for authorization.
onlyOwner guards execution of changeMinBet.
onlyOwner guards execution of withdaw.
Local GameHistory struct is populated within startGame.
startGame reseeds randomNumber after each game.
startGame refreshes prizeFund from the contract balance.
owner is initialized from msg.sender at deployment.
The external msg.sender.transfer can re-enter startGame before state is finalized.
The external owner.transfer can re-enter withdaw before state is finalized.

normalization_plan.reason: _newMinBet is only meaningful as the input argument of changeMinBet and should be absorbed into it.
_number is only meaningful as the input argument of startGame and should be absorbed into it.
_am is only meaningful as the input argument of withdaw and should be absorbed into it.
gameHistory is a transient local struct created inside startGame and should be absorbed into it.
